The '''Subterra Period''' was a period of time in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that lasted from [[8000 BBY]] to [[7000 BBY]]. During this time, there was new mapping of the galactic southern quadrant. The planet of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] acted as an anchor for short [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] snippets, also known as [[praedium]]s. The supply lines that linked [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] were also constructed.<ref name="Atlas" />

The rapid expansion however led to lawlessness in the Rim and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] lost its control on its new territories. This was thought to have contributed to the start of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] 7000 BBY.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Timeline==
*[[8000 BBY]]
**The [[Subterra Period]] begins.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] becomes a member of the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Republic establishes an outpost on the eastern continent of Malastare, and the Gran species soon begin to make their own settlements and politically dominate the world.<ref name="Essential Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
**Goroth Prime is discovered by Corellian pirates.<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>
**The star [[Colu/Legends|Colu]] expands, swallowing the planet [[Clak'dor I]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
*[[7811 BBY]]
**The [[Waymancy Storm]] occurs&mdash;a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. The victorious Republic reverse-engineered the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]]'s power generator technology to develop far more powerful turbolaser weaponry.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[7700s BBY]]
**The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] master crafter [[Lyns Skutroo]] pioneers the [[squintpipe process]] for power generators, having reverse-engineered the Waymancy Storm technology. As a result, shielding technology become important in combat, evolving from simply protection against environmental phenomena.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[7500s BBY]]
**Further refinement of the squintpipe process allows for increases in shield power and regeneration.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[7328 BBY]]
**The warlord [[Shey Tapani]] unites a number of Human colonies under the banner of the [[Tapani Empire]].
*[[7003 BBY]]
**The [[Second Great Schism]] occurs as a number of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] split from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="JvS" />
*[[7000 BBY]]
**The [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] begins in the aftermath of the Second Great Schism.<ref name="JvS" />
**The [[Manderon Period]] begins as the Subterra Period ends.<ref name="Atlas" />
